inputs: CandidateId: Guid, required except for CreateCandidate
CorrelationId: Guid, caller-generated and required for every state-changing operation
CallOutcome: os_sr_callout value, required for RecordCall
rules: CreateCandidate, UpdateCandidate, and workflow actions are allowlisted; caller cannot submit arbitrary target status.
Use authenticated initiating user as actor; never trust actor IDs supplied by clients.
CreateCandidate assigns Dataverse ownerid to the authenticated initiating BSO and omits any Assigned BSO duplicate lookup.
CorrelationId is a caller-generated GUID, required for every state-changing operation and reused only for retries of that logical operation.
Compare ExpectedStatus and Dataverse RowVersion; reject stale/conflicting updates.
Unique Candidate/Call/History correlation keys prevent duplicate Candidate creates, Call Logs, and transition History rows; replay payloads are checked for conflict.
UpdateCandidate uses replacement values; an identical replay is a no-op and creates no Call Log, History row, or status transition; CorrelationId remains required.
Commit Candidate update, Call Log, and exactly one Status History row atomically when applicable.
Answered calls atomically write Call Log, Candidate status, and one History row; non-answer outcomes write only Call Log and do not change status.
Candidate Number is generated by Dataverse, nonpersonal, immutable after create, and protected by a unique alternate key.

Reschedule requires a reason and writes actor, server timestamp, correlation ID, previous/new status, and reason; the action remains unavailable until the later cancellation-attempt boundary is implemented.
No external provider call is made by this Phase 3A operation.
